cues: Firm green cooking fruit is boiled until tender, then mashed with garlic and oil into a savory side.
In Southeast Asian kitchens, ripe fruit is steamed inside sticky rice and served warm with coconut sauce.
People pair the fruit with peanut butter, spreading the nut butter onto slices for an easy snack.
A carpenter sands the tabletop in long strokes, removing rough patches before applying a clear finish.
A baker kneads dough until elastic, then covers the bowl while it rises beside a warm oven.
A cyclist oils the chain, turns the pedals slowly, and checks each gear before leaving.
